frame.name: Area Denial Frame
frame.description: Burst fire Grenade Launcher. Each projectile creates a lingering pool on impact that deals damage over time.

origins.name: Willing Vessel
origins.description: Dealing damage or defeating targets with this weapon gradually grants increased stability, handling, reload speed, and charge rate. This effect gradually decreases over time but is gained more quickly while near allies.

origins.name: Runneth Over
origins.description: Reloading near allies overflows the magazine. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate.

perks.name: Proximity Grenades
perks.description: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

enhanced.name: Proximity Grenades
enhanced.description: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

enhanced.name: Ambitious Assassin
enhanced.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

enhanced.name: Envious Arsenal
enhanced.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves. Increases ammo generation.

perks.name: Eddy Current
perks.description: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified. This effect is improved when you are amplified.

enhanced.name: Eddy Current
enhanced.description: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified; increased reload speed and handling have a longer duration. This effect is significantly improved when you are amplified.

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.description: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

enhanced.name: Feeding Frenzy
enhanced.description: Each rapid final blow with this weapon progressively increases reload speed substantially for a short time.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.description:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

enhanced.name: Pugilist
enhanced.description:
Final blows with this weapon generate improved melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: Stats for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for an improved duration.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.description: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Threat Detector
enhanced.description: Greatly increased reload, stability, and handling when targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.description:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

enhanced.name: Rolling Storm
enhanced.description:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge. 
Gain increased Bolt Charge stacks when you have none.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Harmony
enhanced.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for an improved duration.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Full Court
perks.description: Increases detonation damage as the projectile travels further before exploding.

enhanced.name: Full Court
enhanced.description: Increases detonation damage as the projectile travels farther before exploding. Increases blast radius.

perks.name: Demolitionist

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

enhanced.name: Unrelenting
enhanced.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers improved health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one target.
